signature: SUBROUTINE ZGEQR2P( M, N, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the m by n matrix A. On exit, the elements on and above the diagonal of the array contain the min(m,n) by n upper trapezoidal matrix R (R is upper triangular if $m \ge n$). The diagonal entries of R are real and nonnegative; the elements below the diagonal, with the array `TAU`, represent the unitary matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors (see Further Details).

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors (see Further Details).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
